# exoscale_sks_nodepool_template_list (Data Source)

List the Exoscale [Scalable Kubernetes Service (SKS)](https://community.exoscale.com/product/compute/containers/) Node Pool templates available for a Kubernetes version, latest first.

An [exoscale_sks_nodepool](../resources/sks_nodepool.md) can be pinned on one of them with `template_id`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kube_version` (String) The Kubernetes version of the node pool (`<major>.<minor>` or `<major>.<minor>.<patch>`).
- `zone` (String) The Exoscale [Zone](https://www.exoscale.com/datacenters/) name.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `variant` (String) The template variant to match: `standard`, or `nvidia` for GPU instance types (default: all variants).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `templates` (Attributes List) The list of SKS node pool templates, latest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.


<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The template registration date.
- `id` (String) The SKS node pool template ID.
- `name` (String) The SKS node pool template name.
- `variant` (String) The template variant (`standard` or `nvidia`).
